image_description: A studio-style product shot of a meat cleaver against a plain white background. The cleaver features a large, rectangular stainless steel blade with a visible brand logo ('Huang') etched onto the side. It has a black handle attached to the right side of the blade. The lighting creates soft reflections on the metal surface.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is text on the blade that appears to read 'Huang' or similar. While legible, the font edges have slight softness and irregularity typical of AI-generated text, though it is not complete gibberish. It mimics a brand logo but lacks the crisp vector sharpness of a real photograph.

The transition between the black handle and the metal blade is slightly blurred and lacks the distinct mechanical seam or bolster usually found on real cleavers. It looks somewhat 'melted' or fused rather than mechanically assembled.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cleaver and not a generic knife or chopper variant.
To analyze the legibility and structural integrity of the text/logo on the blade, checking for common AI text artifacts.
To verify if the handle and blade are distinct, physically connected objects or if there is boundary bleeding/fusion at the junction.

focus_areas: Text legibility and font structure on the blade
Physical connectivity and seam definition between handle and blade
Metallic reflection consistency on the blade surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the blade. AI often struggles with small, curved, or reflective surface text. Also, scrutinize the handle attachment point; real cleavers have a tangible bolster or rivet system, whereas AI often smears this connection. Check if the 'steel' texture has realistic micro-scratches or if it looks like smooth, plastic-like grey gradient.
